signal_contract.intended_change: Trust meaningful nighttime pages because noise is suppressed transparently
signal_contract.source_of_conviction: Operators lose trust when alerting systems wake them for noise
signal_contract.limit: Every suppressed alert stays visible and reversible

must_survive.meaning: Trust is earned through silence on noise

artifact_text: Reduce meaningless pages so the SRE can trust the page. Every silence is visible and reversible.
playback_text: It helps an SRE trust the page by staying quiet on noise, while every suppression remains visible and reversible.
